summary: This bill requires individuals convicted of certain federal felonies related to federal contracts, grants, or financial assistance to be listed as an excluded source on the System for Award Management Exclusions list for three years, preventing them from receiving future federal awards, unless an agency head grants a written exemption.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to prevent fraud in federal contracts, grants, and other financial assistance by excluding individuals convicted of certain felonies from receiving federal funds. By reducing fraud, the bill indirectly seeks to make government spending more efficient and prevent wasteful expenditures, thus leading to less overall spending or more effective use of existing funds.
